test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: What is the name of the scheme proposed as a single non-lapsable reserve fund for a share of health from the proceeds of health and education cess?

options.text: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana

solution:
The correct answer is **__Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Nidhi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Nidhi **is proposed as a single non-lapsable reserve fund for a share of health from the proceeds of Health and Education Cess.
 
• It has been levied under Section 136-b of the Finance Act, 2007.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) was announced in the year **2003.**
 
• PMSBY is **an Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some other Important Yojana Provided by Prime Minister:__**

 
 
• ​**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana**.
 
• **PM Garib Kalyan Yojana (PMGKY)** .
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan**. 
 
• **New Jal Shakti Ministry**.
